# Kuhi Anime & Manga Studio API - LLM & AI Agent Specification

> This document is designed for AI assistants, LLMs, and autonomous agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot) to build applications using the Kuhi Anime & Manga Studio API.

## API Overview & Base URL
- **Base URL:** `http://localhost:5646` (replace with active host/port if deployed)
- **CORS:** Enabled (`*`) on all endpoints.
- **Authentication:** Required for `/api/anime/*` and `/api/manga/*`.
  - Query Parameter: `?key=YOUR_API_KEY`
  - HTTP Header: `X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY`
  - Bearer Token: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`
  - Default Demo Key: `kuhi_live_27f453e42c851403fac890ac7d1cc803`

---

## 1. Anime Video & Built-in Player Endpoints

### 1.1 Get Built-in Player & Embed Code
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/anime/player`
- **Query Parameters:**
  - `id` (int, required): AniList Anime ID (e.g., `21` for One Piece, `21827` for Violet Evergarden, `16498` for Attack on Titan)
  - `episode` (int, optional, default `1`): Episode number
  - `type` (string, optional, default `sub`): `sub` or `dub`
  - `server` (string, optional): Preferred server e.g., `DatSaV` (MP4) or `Vidplay` (HLS)
  - `key` (string, required): API Key
- **Response Shape:**
  ```json
  {
    "status": "success",
    "anime_id": 21,
    "episode": 1,
    "audio": "sub",
    "player_url": "http://localhost:5646/player?id=21&episode=1&type=sub&key=YOUR_KEY",
    "iframe_embed": "<iframe src=\"http://localhost:5646/player?id=21&episode=1&type=sub&key=YOUR_KEY\" width=\"100%\" height=\"100%\" frameborder=\"0\" allow=\"autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture\" allowfullscreen></iframe>",
    "features": {
      "skip_buttons": "Rewind 10s & Forward 10s between play and volume",
      "volume_slider": "Horizontal hover-expand slider with drop shadow",
      "aniskip_button": "Floating button at bottom: 85px (above timeline)",
      "timeline_markers": "Yellow highlighted intro and outro intervals"
    },
    "skip_times": {
      "found": true,
      "intro": { "start": 92.5, "end": 182.0 },
      "outro": { "start": 1340.0, "end": 1420.0 }
    }
  }
  ```

### 1.2 Direct Stream Extraction (CORS Proxied)
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/anime/stream`
- **Query Parameters:** `id`, `episode`, `type`, `key`
- **Description:** Returns stream objects containing `stream_url` (pre-proxied through `/proxy_mp4` or `/proxy_m3u8` to prevent 403 Forbidden / CORS blocks), raw video URLs, and WebVTT subtitles.

### 1.3 Full Episodes List
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/anime/episodes/{anime_id}`
- **Query Parameters:** `key`
- **Description:** Returns total episode count, banner, HD poster, and an array of episodes with numbers, titles, and pre-built `player_url` and `iframe_embed` links.

### 1.4 Standalone Web Player Page
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/player?id={anime_id}&episode={episode}&key={key}`
- **Description:** Standalone web player powered by Artplayer with:
  - Horizontal hover-expand volume bar (soft shadow, no square box).
  - 10s Rewind and 10s Forward buttons between Play and Volume.
  - Floating AniSkip button at `bottom: 85px`.
  - Yellow highlighted intervals on timeline seekbar.
  - Multi-server & subtitle selection.

---

## 2. Manga, Manhwa & Manhua Endpoints

### 2.1 Search Titles (Enriched with Official AniList HD Covers)
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/manga/search`
- **Query Parameters:**
  - `q` (string, optional): Title keyword (e.g. `Solo Leveling`, `Omniscient Reader`)
  - `type` (string, optional, default `all`): `all`, `manhwa`, `manga`, or `manhua`
  - `source` (string, optional, default `all`): `all`, `vortex`, `toraka`, `mangadex`, or `anilist`
  - `page` (int, optional, default `1`)
  - `key` (string, required): API Key
- **Response Shape:**
  ```json
  {
    "page": 1,
    "total": 34,
    "results": [
      {
        "title": "Solo Leveling: Ragnarok",
        "slug": "solo-leveling-ragnarok",
        "source": "vortex",
        "type": "MANHWA",
        "poster": "https://s4.anilist.co/file/anilistcdn/media/manga/cover/large/bx178663-rR9k8jNq.jpg",
        "description": "...",
        "rating": 8.4,
        "genres": ["Action", "Fantasy"],
        "info_url": "http://localhost:5646/api/manga/info/solo-leveling-ragnarok?source=vortex&key=YOUR_KEY"
      }
    ]
  }
  ```

### 2.2 Popular Titles
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/manga/popular`
- **Query Parameters:** `type`, `source`, `key`

### 2.3 Manga Details & Chapter List
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/manga/info/{slug_or_id}`
- **Query Parameters:** `source` (default `vortex`), `key`
- **Response Shape:**
  Returns metadata, synopsis, status, genres, HD poster, and `chapters` list:
  ```json
  {
    "title": "The Emperor's Sword",
    "slug": "the-emperors-sword",
    "poster": "https://s4.anilist.co/file/anilistcdn/media/manga/cover/large/bx175116-v0V2K.jpg",
    "total_chapters": 90,
    "chapters": [
      {
        "id": "33926",
        "number": "1",
        "title": "Chapter 1",
        "is_locked": false,
        "reader_url": "http://localhost:5646/manga/reader/33926?source=vortex&key=YOUR_KEY",
        "chapter_api": "http://localhost:5646/api/manga/chapter/33926?source=vortex&key=YOUR_KEY"
      }
    ]
  }
  ```

### 2.4 Chapter Page Images (CORS & Anti-Hotlinking Proxied)
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/manga/chapter/{chapter_id}`
- **Query Parameters:** `source` (default `vortex`), `key`
- **Response Shape:**
  ```json
  {
    "chapter_id": "33926",
    "number": 1,
    "title": "Chapter 1",
    "source": "vortex",
    "pages_count": 198,
    "next_chapter": "33927",
    "prev_chapter": null,
    "reader_url": "http://localhost:5646/manga/reader/33926?source=vortex&key=YOUR_KEY",
    "iframe_embed": "<iframe src=\"http://localhost:5646/manga/reader/33926?source=vortex&key=YOUR_KEY\" width=\"100%\" height=\"800\" frameborder=\"0\" allowfullscreen></iframe>",
    "pages": [
      {
        "page": 1,
        "url": "http://localhost:5646/proxy_image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.vortexscans.org%2F...&referer=https%3A%2F%2Fvortexscans.org%2F",
        "raw_url": "https://storage.vortexscans.org/..."
      }
    ]
  }
  ```

### 2.5 Standalone Webtoon Reader
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/manga/reader/{chapter_id}?source={source}&key={key}`
- **Description:** Full responsive vertical continuous strip reader with dark mode, zoom toggles, and next/prev chapter navigation.

---

## 3. Proxy Endpoints (Zero-Config CORS Bypassing)
- `/proxy_image?url={URL}&referer={REFERER}`: Serves images with permissive CORS headers.
- `/proxy_mp4?url={URL}&referer={REFERER}`: Byte-range streaming for MP4 files.
- `/proxy_m3u8?url={URL}&referer={REFERER}`: Rewrites HLS playlists to route segments through proxy.
- `/proxy_sub?url={URL}`: Serves WebVTT/SRT subtitles with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`.

---

## 4. Example AI Code Prompts & Snippets

### Quick iFrame Embed for HTML / React:
```html
<!-- Anime Video Player -->
<iframe
  src="http://localhost:5646/player?id=21&episode=1&type=sub&key=kuhi_live_27f453e42c851403fac890ac7d1cc803"
  width="100%"
  height="600"
  frameborder="0"
  allow="autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture; encrypted-media"
  allowfullscreen>
</iframe>

<!-- Manga Chapter Reader -->
<iframe
  src="http://localhost:5646/manga/reader/33926?source=vortex&key=kuhi_live_27f453e42c851403fac890ac7d1cc803"
  width="100%"
  height="850"
  frameborder="0"
  allowfullscreen>
</iframe>
```

### Complete JavaScript Fetch Integration:
```javascript
const API_BASE = "http://localhost:5646";
const API_KEY = "kuhi_live_27f453e42c851403fac890ac7d1cc803";

// 1. Get Anime Built-in Player
async function getPlayerEmbed(animeId, episode = 1) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/anime/player?id=${animeId}&episode=${episode}&key=${API_KEY}`);
  return await res.json(); // contains .iframe_embed and .player_url
}

// 2. Search Manga & get HD Covers
async function searchManga(query) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/manga/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&type=manhwa&key=${API_KEY}`);
  return await res.json(); // contains .results with .poster and .info_url
}

// 3. Get Chapter Pages
async function getChapterImages(chapterId) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/manga/chapter/${chapterId}?source=vortex&key=${API_KEY}`);
  return await res.json(); // contains .pages with proxied image .url
}
```
